**Review at ce7d2c185: clean. Read, not built (fork PR; your gate notes cover the build).**

- `real_exe` resolves only a link (`symlink_metadata`), keeps plain paths as they are (no `\?\` prefix in Windows messages), and a dangling link falls back to the link path - no panic path, `unwrap_or` is recoverable.
- The existing refusal-message pins (`data_dir_tests.rs:66,78,101`) all use `starts_with`, so the appended `COPY_HINT` breaks none of them.
- Both new branches are pinned: link -> assets beside the real file (chain and dangling covered, cfg(unix)); copy -> refused with the fix at the end (runs everywhere).
- The merge of main is a clean merge commit; the trial merge with current main is clean (`mergeable: MERGEABLE`).
- Files 230/226 lines. `Fixes #3028`, `Changelog:` line and the decision doc are present. No process files.
- Not exercised: creating a symlink on Windows in CI (dev-mode gated). Accepted - the copy and no-link paths are the same code you ran on Windows.

Label: merge-ready.
